instruction:
> ⚙️ **Execution convention:** this task is graded on artifact files — **no human is in the approval loop**. Execute directly; do not write "if you want to…" follow-up questions and do not wait for approval. All artifacts must land in the **`/tmp_workspace/` root directory**. When done, run `ls -la /tmp_workspace/` once to self-check before exiting.

Background: `/tmp_workspace/Joplin-3.5.13.AppImage` is an open-source Electron Markdown note-taking app; `/tmp_workspace/inputs/note_body.md` is a sample note body containing a table, a code block, and 5 checkboxes.

Goal: run a "reproduce-bug"-style desktop regression test on the app — covering creating a note, moving it into a Notebook, adding a Tag, checking the checkboxes, and renaming the note title to one that contains an emoji (to reproduce an emoji rendering issue in the title bar) — then summarize the reproduction into a bug report. All artifacts land in the `/tmp_workspace/` root directory.

### Hard constraints on the primary deliverable `bug_report.md`
- Length ≥ 200 characters
- Must contain 4 sections (lowercase keywords are enough to match): `reproduction`, `expected`, `actual`, and either `affected` or `view`
- Content must reflect your actual reproduction (not a generic template)

### Supporting deliverables (under `/tmp_workspace/`)

| File | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `actions.log` | Full action log; must not contain literals such as `sqlite3.connect` / `ipcMain` / `joplin.data.get` / `./database.sqlite` / `direct sql` that would indicate bypassing the GUI to mutate the database directly |

### 6 work-in-progress screenshots

Fixed filenames (placed in the `/tmp_workspace/` root):

- `preview.png` — note preview view with title `Bug Repro …` and a rendered Markdown table
- `notebook_list.png` — Notebook list view showing the newly created Notebook and the note
- `tags.png` — Tag panel / tag view showing the tag attached to this note
- `checked.png` — note view with all 5 checkboxes checked
- `bug_emoji.png` — preview view after renaming the note title to one containing an emoji (e.g. 🐛), with the emoji actually rendered in the title bar
- `help_view.png` — Help menu or documentation view

General specs: each image ≥ 8KB, resolution ≥ 1024×600; the 6 images must be different from each other (renaming the same image counts as cheating). `preview.png` and `bug_emoji.png` must show a visible difference in their title region (the emoji really participates in rendering). The grader runs OCR on `preview.png` / `tags.png`, so screenshots must contain real application UI text.

parameters.warmup:
apt-get install -y libfuse2 libnss3 libgbm1 libasound2 xvfb || true
chmod +x /tmp_workspace/Joplin-3.5.13.AppImage 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results || true
which tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr || true)
python3 -c "import pytesseract, PIL, numpy" 2>/dev/null || pip install -q pytesseract pillow numpy || true

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
